facts.text: SUNY Cortland operates educational facilities at Raquette Lake in the Adirondacks, including Camp Huntington, the only National Historic Landmark in the SUNY system.

sources.title: Outdoor Education and Off-Campus Locations - SUNY Cortland
sources.quote: Located in the heart of the Adirondack Mountains, SUNY Cortland's educational facilities on Raquette Lake include the Antlers lodge, Kirby Camp and Camp Huntington, the only National Historic Landmark in the SUNY system.
